item.name: Test: consolidated POST and linking (v1.1)
item.description:
Covers endpoints:

- POST:/api/v2/partitionings (idempotent, 0..N parents: 201 created / 200 existing, 404 unknown parent and the child is not created, 409 cycle, 400 more than 100 distinct parents, copyMeasureDefinitions true / false)
    
- PATCH:/api/v2/partitionings/{partitioningId}/ancestors (both copy flags required: 400 without them; 204 late link, which also adds the descendants of the linked partitioning to the flow of the new parent)
    
- GET:/api/v2/partitionings/{partitioningId}/ancestors (200, exact set of the direct parents)
    
- GET:/api/v2/partitionings/{partitioningId}/measures
    
- GET:/api/v2/partitionings/{partitioningId}/additional-data
    
- GET:/api/v2/partitionings/{partitioningId}/main-flow
    
- GET:/api/v2/flows/{flowId}/partitionings
    
- POST:/api/v2/partitionings/{partitioningId}/checkpoints
    
- GET:/api/v2/partitionings?partitioning=
    
All partitionings of this folder use the unique suffix in the collection variable v11_suffix (regenerated unconditionally by the first request of the folder, so a re-run after an aborted run starts clean); all ids are kept in collection variables with the prefix v11_. Ids of probe requests for unknown partitionings are >= 9007199254740000 (never allocated by the database sequence). This folder is an HTTP-contract smoke test with one happy path per behaviour; the edge cases (boundaries, self-link, copy-flag matrix) are covered by the database and server tests. Error responses are checked by status code and envelope shape (message, requestId), not by message wording.
